title: Snow Island
body:
Snowy Peaks is a mountainous region between the Taiga and Icelands Biomes. Snowy Peaks has mostly the same resources as what's in the Taiga, main differences are the inclusion of Blue Ice and Snow, the other difference being the snow on the tree leaves, but this doesn't effect the value of the tree.

At the start of Snowy Peaks is a small cave that leads you to the Unknown Person for the Lab Card Quest.

On top of a mountain contains the Heavenly Shrine, a sundial and compass mechanism that is only active during Fridays and saturdays, which serves as the primary method of spawning the Heavenly Tree.
